verdict.rationale: Probes confirm a live llms.txt at docs.wandb.ai, organized into product sections (418 product pages). Individual docs pages are served as Markdown (weave.md) and point back to the llms.txt index. On top of that, the W&B MCP Server gives agents direct access to documentation, and W&B Skills covers the Weave SDK for coding agents. Missing for 10: no evidence of a single full-content dump (e.g., llms-full.txt), and no independent hands-on report of agents actually consuming these docs.
